description: Unit test class for the TriTuple class, containing multiple test methods that verify the behavior of TriTuple including argument order, equality, inequality, and null handling.

classes.name: TriTupleTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing TriTuple functionalities.

methods.name: testOrderOfArguments
methods.description: Tests that the TriTuple correctly preserves the order of its arguments and retrieves them as expected.

methods.name: testEqualsSameType
methods.description: Verifies that two TriTuple instances with the same values are considered equal and have the same hash code.

methods.name: testEqualsDifferentType
methods.description: Ensures that TriTuple instances with different types or differing values are not considered equal.

methods.name: testNotEqual1
methods.description: Checks that two TriTuples with different first elements are not equal.

methods.name: testNotEqual2
methods.description: Checks that two TriTuples with different second elements are not equal.

methods.name: testNotEqual3
methods.description: Checks that two TriTuples with different third elements are not equal.

methods.name: testAllNull
methods.description: Asserts that creating a TriTuple with all null values throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: expectNotEqual
methods.description: Helper method to verify that two TriTuple instances are not equal.
